children: Karvas Toll grew up in the slums of
, where his future was limited to joining a gang or being a victim of one. After watching an Imperial propaganda program on

, Toll realized that the Empire was the best way to break out of his situation and joined up. Amazingly, instead of shipping Toll off to some distant warfront, the Imperials realized that he was a natural as a spy and surveillance expert, as well as deadly with a blaster and a blade. After a training stint offworld, Toll returned to
cells there, using his knowledge of the planet to carry out clandestine acts on behalf of the Empire.

Toll considers himself a patriot and believes that the Empire has the galaxy's best interests at heart. Quiet, observant, and stealthy, Toll is often used by his handlers to clean up after missions gone awry or to step in when further assistance is needed. He dresses like a native of
, but his demeanor makes it clear that he is dangerous, and most citizens give him a wide berth on the streets.

Toll excels at sneaking into locations unnoticed and waiting for just the right moment to strike from the shadows. Once on board the heroes' ship, he cuts a secondary power circuit and plunges the YT-1300 into darkness. An expert at close combat, Toll uses his
to engage the heroes in melee after targeting them with a few blaster shots. He tries to move as swiftly as possible to get close to

and use the neurobiologist as a shield, buying time until his reinforcements arrive. As a loyal Imperial agent, Toll knows the penalty for failure and fights to the death. If he is close to being taken down, Toll turns his blaster or blade against Narubo to deny the Rebels the prize.
